operational-example.copy: Use Toast for short, non-blocking feedback after a user or system event: saved changes, sync status, export progress, undo, offline recovery, or a recoverable error.

scenario.title: Fleet console feedback
scenario.meta: Feedback after actions and system events

items.label: Export is being prepared.
items.description: You can keep working while the file is generated.

items.label: Vehicle sync failed.
items.description: Last saved data is still available.

rationale: Toast confirms or explains a recent event without blocking the task.

The ZIP reference confirms an inverse surface, compact rounded frame, severity icon, optional single action, and dismiss control; Flow governs color, typography, density, elevation, and live-region semantics.
The base message should work as one concise line; supporting description is optional and only explains consequence or recovery.
